title: Big Caring sets Main Market IPO at RM1.08 apiece, shareholders to pocket RM1.4 bil
text:
Big Caring sets Main Market IPO at RM1.08 apiece, shareholders to pocket RM1.4 bil Thursday 29 Oct 2026 BURSA SGX Home 
 IPO Make The Edge Malaysia your preferred source on Google KUALA LUMPUR (Oct 29): Pharmacy chains operator Big Caring Group Bhd is looking to raise RM2.03 billion in Malaysia's second-largest listing this year.
 The initial public offering (IPO) is priced at RM1.08 per share. A group of shareholders — including managing director Lee Meng Chuan and his wife Lim Sin Yin, who is also an executive director — are pocketing RM462 million individually and through their joint vehicle from sale of their existing shares.
 Private equity firm Creador, meanwhile, is reaping RM933 million. All in all, they will collect RM1.4 billion, or more than two-thirds of the IPO proceeds, under the offer for sale tranche. 
 The company, which operates under brands BIG Pharmacy and CARiNG Pharmacy chains, will get RM637.8 million from public issue of new shares.
 “Changing demographics, greater health awareness and demand for accessible healthcare continue to drive growth in our industry,” Lee said at the launch of the listing prospectus on Thursday.
 Applications for the Main Market IPO will close on Nov 5 and listing is scheduled for Nov 19.
 Debt-fuelled growth
 Big Caring will allocate 90% of the IPO proceeds to trim bank borrowings that totalled RM1.7 billion in the company’s balance sheet as of end-August.
 Bulk of the debt was taken to finance previous acquisitions — RM888.3 million for Caring Pharmacy from 7-Eleven Malaysia Holdings Bhd (KL: SEM ) in 2023, RM249.4 million for pharmaceutical distributor Medispec, and RM32.8 million for controlling stake in physiotherapy chain Your Physio.
 The company is also setting aside RM30 million to set up new distribution centre in Klang to enhance its nationwide logistics network, with the remaining RM37.1 million earmarked for covering listing expenses.
 Lee and Lim, both trained pharmacists, opened their first retail outlet in Damansara Uptown in 2006.
 Since then, the company has expanded nationwide with 668 outlets under several brands with 24.2% market share as of end-Sept. Other brands under its wing include Georgetown Pharmacy, Wellings, Ting Pharmacy, and iCare Pharmacy.
 IPO backers
 The IPO is backed by cornerstone investors that include fund managers Aberdeen Group plc and AHAM Asset Management, and International Finance Corporation, the private-sector arm of the World Bank.
 Cornerstone investors — typically large institutional investors such as pension funds and insurers — commit to take up a portion of IPO shares before they are marketed to other retail and institutional investors. Their presence helps to build up other investors’ confidence to invest in the IPO.
 At the IPO price, Big Caring will have a market capitalisation of RM8 billion, valuing the company at about 42 times its trailing earnings upon listing. Net profit for the financial year ended June 30, 2026 increased over 62% to RM231.8 million while revenue grew over 18% to RM4 billion.
 Maybank Investment Bank and RHB Investment Bank are the joint principal advisers, joint global coordinators, joint bookrunners, joint managing underwriters and joint underwriters for its IPO.
 AmInvestment Bank serves as joint principal advisers, joint global coordinators, joint bookrunners and joint underwriters, while UBS is the joint global coordinators and joint bookrunners.
